utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, are we still on for book club this week?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yep, we’re still on for this week. I’ll stop by after I finish a couple errands.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — what time should I expect you?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Noah — if the book club needs anything, I’ve got tools and a free hand.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Gus — that’s really kind of you. I might need a reminder about when the next book club meeting is.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Happy to help—just let me know the date and I’ll remind you. I’m glad to be useful for the book club.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the book club? I heard they’re picking a new title soon—sounds like it might be a good one. Have you heard any favorites yet?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Not yet, but I’m hoping they pick something easy to get hold of. I’d hate for us to agree and then spend forever tracking down copies.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I know what you mean—nothing kills the buzz like a hard-to-find book. I’ll ask around and see if anyone’s heard what titles are floating about.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’d be glad to help with the book club. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Sam — could you confirm where we’re meeting for book club this week?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m not sure yet, but I can find out and let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Uli, I’m putting together the book club meet-up this week—want me to save you a spot?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Quinn. Please save me a spot if there’s room—I’d like to come by.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’ll save you a spot. I’ll send the details as soon as I have them!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll get the book club details organized, and we can pick a time that works for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — just send me the details when you have them.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Will do, Leo — I’ll send the details once I’ve got the time and place set.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me of the book title and when the club meets? I want to make sure I’ve got the details right before I say yes.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh, I’m sorry—I’m a bit late and I don’t have the details in front of me. I can check and get back to you right away.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Dane. Please check and let me know the title and meeting time when you can.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can check our school schedule and see what evenings might work for book club.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That would be great, thank you — I really appreciate you checking. Once you know, I can help pick the best evening for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’ll look at the calendar tonight and send you a couple of good options. Then we can choose whichever works best for the group.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I haven’t heard the latest yet—what’s the book club reading this time?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: We’re reading a mystery novel this month—pretty twisty, but fun. I can send you the title if you want!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yes, please—I’d love the title. I’m a little behind on the neighborhood updates!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—what’s the book club reading next?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Which book did they pick again?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m blanking on the title—can you remind me?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I might join if the timing works out—what book are you all reading?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—I'm pretty sure it's a mystery novel, but I keep mixing up the title. I can check and let you know!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, that’d be great—I’d like to know before I decide. If it works, I’d be glad to stop by.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll check with the group and let you know the book club plan soon.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Vik—just let me know if we need any snacks or extra chairs.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll ask the group and see if we need snacks or extra chairs, then I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I haven’t heard any updates yet — what’s the book club reading this month?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m not sure yet—I haven’t heard the pick for this month. I can check in and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, that’d be great — just let me know when you find out.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — the book club! I’m a bit blank on the details, but I’m happy to help if you remind me what we’re picking up next.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: We’re picking up the next book for book club, and I’m happy to remind everyone of the details if needed.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Vik — I appreciate that. Just tell me the title and where to pick it up, and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the book club. Remind me which book we’re on again?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: We’re on "The Silent Patient" this month.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Ah, got it — The Silent Patient. I’ll try to remember that this time.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Eli — I’ve got a few extra chairs and can lend a thermos if the book club needs them.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s kind of you, Gus. I’ll put the chairs and thermos on the plan for book club.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Glad to help, Eli — just let me know when you need them.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Quinn — I’m happy to help with the book club. What did you want to decide first?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great! Let’s decide the next meeting time first, and then I can send out an invite to everyone.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That sounds good to me — what time were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, I’d love to help bring everyone together for book club—what’s the next read?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve got the next read in mind: it’s at the community center this Thursday, and I’ll bring the sign-up list.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect — I’ll help spread the word and make sure everyone feels welcome. Thursday at the community center sounds great!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Cleo — I’m glad you’re here. Want to chat about the next book club pick?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sure, Rosa — I’m happy to chat about it. What books are you considering?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’m thinking we could pick something cozy and easy to discuss, maybe a mystery or a short novel. If you’d like, I can bring a couple of options to our next meeting.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve only heard bits and pieces about the book club—what’s it like?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: It’s pretty relaxed—mostly just folks talking about the book and sharing opinions. Do you want to come by sometime?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds nice—I’d be up for coming by sometime and listening in.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m in — just send me the book title and when we’re meeting.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect — I’ll send the title and the meeting time this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks — I’ll look for it this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’d be happy to help with the book club. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm what time the book club meets?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m not sure yet — let me check the details and get back to you.
